source: Spartacus unified gladiator/beast art QA; connected-mask extraction 2026-10-21

optionalMotionRules.roarMeaning: special intimidation or vocalization, NEVER substitute for guard

rules.description: Keep approved face, costume, proportions and weapon/armor appearance across every frame
rules.action: Compare contact sheets with approved source visually before release

rules.description: One character, exactly one motion, eight sequential key poses; no mixed-action boards

Generate exactly ONE transparent 4x2 RGBA sheet per character and action, eight distinct complete frames. No minimum sheet, frame, reference, or visible subject dimensions. Per-frame anatomy must be intact; neighbor body parts are forbidden.
rules.action: Brief generator to deliver ONE 4x2 RGBA sheet at any valid size. Check identity, frame ownership, alpha, clean cuts, consistent scale and ground anchors; never reject solely for small source pixels.

rules.description: Immediately before each generation and EACH regeneration attempt, SpriteForge MUST brief the operator/provider on the locked approved reference, character, ONE action, eight poses in ONE 4x2 sheet, size-independent grid layout, foot anchor, safe gutters, prior faults and all mandatory ownership policies. No rendering may begin without a job-bound acknowledgement.
rules.action: Generate detailed human-readable briefing.md and machine-readable briefing.json, make provider explicitly acknowledge every block rule and execution plan; refuse if missing, expired, incomplete, wrong job or policy drift.

rules.description: No duplicated silhouettes, ghost limbs, multiple monsters in one frame
rules.action: Fail ambiguous merged components and request re-generation

rules.description: Find all RGBA connected silhouettes from the complete uncropped source sheet. 4x2 rectangles are seed search regions only. Preserve the entire single-owner silhouette even if tail/weapon/paw crosses a grid seam. Never clip by cell bounds or keep only the largest island.
rules.action: Assign by unique per-pose inner-core evidence, generate a full owned-alpha mask, copy unchanged RGBA to same-sized padded frame canvases. Block fused/two-core or detached/unowned regions.

rules.description: Size cannot prove belonging. No small-part auto-deletion or dominant-blob shortcut; separated own weapon/tail requires proof or review, neighboring head must never be kept.
rules.action: Fail uncertain ownership rather than invent a partition. Keep approved old game sprite until full quality gate passes.

rules.description: Crossing a nominal rectangle is ALLOWED if one connected component has one unique frame core. Actual fused poses claiming two cores or orphans are BLOCKING; do not regenerate valid one-core overhang.
rules.action: Report exact source component, claimed pose indices and affected bounds; regenerate only the one bad action when ambiguous.

rules.description: Any generation or cutting QC failure automatically invokes regeneration for the SAME action: 8 complete frames, known error diagnosis, isolated cuts, re-QA and before/after 8-frame PNG/GIF review.
rules.action: Each retry's job must carry exact failing frame numbers and error codes. Never mark ready without technical pass; avoid user questions for known errors and only escalate persistent unknown root causes. Keep old approved art until full animation/game QA pass.

rules.description: Preserve silhouette and source pixel fidelity, and use shared proportional output gutters. A rectangular seam is NOT permission to amputate a connected limb.
rules.action: Expand output canvas with unchanged source geometry; do not shrink or re-scale the actor to fit a predetermined cell.

rules.description: All frames same pixel scale and shared canvas origin; planted stance stable, but intentional pounce/death poses may differ. No per-frame bbox-centered zoom.
rules.action: Use stable planted feet, never per-frame recenter or zoom

rules.description: Attack anticipation and advance, recoil backward, leap arc; no accidental frame bobbing
rules.action: Render animation GIF with frame DX/DY and inspect displacement

rules.description: Guard required; roar extra, not replacement
Card preview uses idle animation, never separate still thumbnail
rules.action: Use 8-frame idle canvas with no still art

rules.description: Selected card may play roar once; standoff may play roar with cooldown if actual art exists
rules.action: Never fake roar by reusing an attack pose

rules.description: On every gladiator and beast HP=0, map death pose, play 8 sequential frames, hold final frame. Never overlay hit flash on dying body or allow idle to replace death.

Do not publish on successful PNG generation alone. Require mask ownership, foot consistency, cross-action scale, pose/frame map, death/intro playback, facing/layer/timing VFX, and browser release verification.
rules.action: Preserve old manifest until safe deployment

automaticRecovery.retryScope: one creature, one motion, ONE 4x2 transparent sheet of eight complete poses at any source resolution
automaticRecovery.userInterruptionPolicy: Solve reproducible diagnosed issues automatically; escalate only after repeated unresolved or unknown-root-cause failures.
automaticRecovery.releaseGate: 8/8 UNIQUE CONNECTED MASK OWNERS + common anchors + runtime motion/VFX QA + review + live verification
automaticRecovery.referenceDetailRule: NO_MINIMUM_PIXEL_SIZE; preserve submitted pixels and visual design; do not use simple enlargement as proof of detail

stages.method: Approved reference SHA + action contract + full source sheet immutable
Connected alpha components across WHOLE sheet; nominal 4x2 cores seed ownership but never slice actor
If component enters multiple frame cores OR unowned/detached fragments remain, BLOCK; no largest-blob/noise-area deletion and no guessed limb reconstruction
Same padded canvas, same root/foot anchor, no per-frame resize, protect intentional airborne/lying poses
Verify every required motion is mapped and actually plays; no idle overriding death; correct VFX facing, layer and anatomy contacts
Technical pass + art review + real gameplay pass + deployed hash check, otherwise preserve prior version
